you’ll catch it phrase

also you’ll get a hiding, you’re in for it, you’ll be for it, you’ll get a beating, you’ll get what for

classical

Plaut. Merc. 168: Hercle vērō vāpulābis, nisi jam loquere aut hinc abīs.
Plaut. Amph. 440

Vāpulābis.

you’ll get a beating

(vōx cōmica: Plaut.)

The future of vāpulō, be beaten: active in form, passive in sense.

Examples

  • Hercle vērō vāpulābis, nisi jam loquere aut hinc abīs.

    By Hercules, you really will catch it, unless you speak up this minute or get out of here.Plaut. Merc. 168

  • nunc, quandō ego sum, vāpulābis, nī hinc abīs, ignōbilis

    now, since that is who I am, you’ll get a beating unless you clear off, you nobodyPlaut. Amph. 440

See also strike, threat, punish.

SourcesLewis & Short: vapulo

Plautus, Amphitruo 440; Mercator 168.
